item.throwing_disc.disc.tooltip: Right-click to throw. Pierces mobs and ricochets off blocks.
item.throwing_disc.disc.tooltip_return: Returns to you after a short flight.
enchantment.throwing_disc.ramming.desc: The disc no longer damages mobs; it breaks blocks based on its material tier. Incompatible with Impaling.
enchantment.throwing_disc.aerodynamics.d: Increases flight distance by 1 block per level, up to level 5.
enchantment.throwing_disc.expansion.desc: Ramming breaks blocks in a wider area, +1 block radius per level, up to level 2.
enchantment.throwing_disc.ricochet.desc: Increases the maximum number of bounces by 1 per level, up to level 5.
enchantment.throwing_disc.magnetic_retur: Increases return speed per level; with Ramming, carries broken block drops back to you. Up to level 3.
enchantment.throwing_disc.preservation.d: Leaves the disc at 1 durability instead of breaking.
